item.title: meta-flutter/meta-flutter
item.description: Yocto/OpenEmbedded layer for Flutter on embedded Linux. Builds the Flutter SDK, engine and Dart SDK from source, four embedders (ivi-homescreen, flutter-auto, flutter-pi, flutter-elinux) and application recipes. Branches for master, wrynose, scarthgap, kirkstone and dunfell.
